name: AppSheet
tagline: AppSheet is Google's no-code platform for building mobile and web applications directly from spreadsheet and database data. Its AI-powered app creation assistant generates a functional app from a description, and automation rules can trigger actions based on data changes. Enterprises use it to replace manual processes with mobile workflows.
